days.title: North and West Coast Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Kust till kustleden
stops.detail: The Coast to Coast trail extends over 370 kilometers from Sölvesborg in the east to Örlid near Ängelholm in the west.

stops.name: Bjärehalvön
stops.detail: It connects the east coast (where you have a connection to the Blekinge Trail) with the west coast (where you finally circumnavigate the Bjäre Peninsula) and runs through the north of Scania.

stops.name: Ven
stops.detail: Additionally, a circular route is marked on the island of Ven.

days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Skrylle
stops.detail: From an alternative route through the Skrylle recreation area, a detour leads into Dalby Söderskog, one of Sweden's smallest and oldest national parks.

stops.name: Nationalpark Söderåsen
stops.detail: This 162-kilometer-long route of the Skåneleden, which crosses the province from northwest to southeast, leads among other things through the Söderåsen National Park.
